en.title: Switch 2's 2026 Lineup Revealed: Splatoon Raiders, Oblivion, and More!
en.summary: Nintendo's next-gen console is shaping up with a robust launch window, featuring exclusive titles and highly anticipated remasters. Get ready for a wave of new adventures hitting the Switch 2 in 2026 and beyond.
en.body:
The era of the **Nintendo Switch 2** is drawing nearer, and with it, a tantalizing glimpse into its future library has emerged. Nintendo has begun to unveil its plans for the second half of 2026 and beyond, promising a compelling mix of exclusive titles, exciting third-party ports, and the crucial benefit of backward compatibility with the original **Switch**. This early look suggests a console designed to hit the ground running, offering something for every type of gamer.

## The First Wave of Switch 2 Titles

Leading the charge is **Splatoon Raiders**, slated for a July 23, 2026 release, marking the franchise's first single-player focused spin-off. Players will step into the role of a customizable Mechanic, embarking on solo adventures across a sprawling, progressively unlockable map, with the promise of four-player co-op. Following closely is **Big Walk**, arriving August 4, 2026. Developed by the creative minds behind **Untitled Goose Game**, this title embraces the "friendslop" genre with an ambitious open-world experience for up to 11 players, complete with proxy chat for seamless communication during its puzzle-filled adventures.

For fans of challenging combat, **Lies of P: Complete Edition** is set to launch digitally on August 6, 2026, with a physical release following in October. This beloved Souls-like receives a dedicated **Switch 2** version, enhanced with the **Overture** expansion and unique quality-of-life improvements tailored for the new hardware. Perhaps the most surprising announcement is **The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion Remastered**, with a release date of August 11, 2026. This marks a significant return for a classic RPG on a Nintendo platform, promising a visually enhanced and potentially feature-rich experience for a new generation of players.

## What This Means for Gamers

The confirmed lineup for the **Nintendo Switch 2** in 2026 signals a clear strategy from Nintendo: leverage established fan favorites while embracing ambitious new experiences and welcoming major third-party hits. The inclusion of **Splatoon Raiders** as an exclusive demonstrates Nintendo's commitment to its core IPs, while the arrival of titles like **Lies of P** and **The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion Remastered** speaks to its efforts in securing a diverse and high-quality third-party software library. This diverse range of genres and gameplay styles suggests that the **Switch 2** aims to be a versatile console, capable of satisfying both dedicated fans and newcomers alike, ensuring a strong start to its lifecycle.

## What's Next

While specific dates for other titles like **Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters** and **Xenoblade Chronicles Switch 2 Edition** are still to be announced, the confirmed releases paint a picture of a packed 2026. Keep an eye out for further announcements regarding **Orbitals**, **Another Eden Begins**, **Turok Origins**, **The Eternal Life of Goldman**, and **Witchbrook**, all slated for release throughout 2026, further solidifying the **Switch 2's** promising launch window.

es.title: Llega la era de Switch 2: Splatoon Raiders, Oblivion y más en 2026
es.summary: La consola de próxima generación de Nintendo se está perfilando con una ventana de lanzamiento robusta, que incluye títulos exclusivos y remasters muy esperados. Prepárate para una oleada de nuevas aventuras que llegarán a Switch 2 en 2026 y más allá. La estrategia de Nintendo para su nueva consola es clara: combinar experiencias establecidas con nuevas y ambiciosas, y atraer a grandes éxitos de terceros.
es.body:
La era de **Nintendo Switch 2** está cerca, y con ella, se ha obtenido un vistazo tentador a su futura biblioteca. Nintendo ha comenzado a desvelar sus planes para la segunda mitad de 2026 y más allá, prometiendo una mezcla convincente de títulos exclusivos, emocionantes ports de terceros y la crucial ventaja de la compatibilidad hacia atrás con el **Switch** original. Esta primera mirada sugiere una consola diseñada para empezar con fuerza, ofreciendo algo para cada tipo de jugador.


## La primera oleada de títulos de Switch 2

Al frente de esta oleada se encuentra **Splatoon Raiders**, programado para su lanzamiento el 23 de julio de 2026, marcando el primer spin-off enfocado en un solo jugador de la franquicia. Los jugadores asumirán el papel de un Mecánico personalizable, embarcándose en aventuras en solitario a través de un mapa progresivamente desbloqueable, con la promesa de cooperación para cuatro jugadores. A continuación, llega **Big Walk**, el 4 de agosto de 2026. Desarrollado por las mentes creativas detrás de **Untitled Goose Game**, este título abraza el género "friendslop" con una ambiciosa experiencia de mundo abierto para hasta 11 jugadores, completa con chat proxy para una comunicación sin problemas durante sus aventuras llenas de acertijos.


Para los fanáticos del combate desafiante, **Lies of P: Edición Completa** está programado para su lanzamiento digital el 6 de agosto de 2026, con un lanzamiento físico posterior en octubre. Este Souls-like muy querido recibe una versión dedicada para **Switch 2**, mejorada con la expansión **Overture** y mejoras únicas de calidad de vida adaptadas para el nuevo hardware. Quizás el anuncio más sorprendente sea **The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion Remastered**, con una fecha de lanzamiento del 11 de agosto de 2026. Esto marca un regreso significativo para un clásico RPG en una plataforma de Nintendo, prometiendo una experiencia visualmente mejorada y potencialmente llena de características para una nueva generación de jugadores.


## Qué significa esto para los jugadores

La alineación confirmada para **Nintendo Switch 2** en 2026 señala una estrategia clara de Nintendo: aprovechar favoritos establecidos mientras se abrazan experiencias nuevas y ambiciosas, y atraer a grandes éxitos de terceros. La inclusión de **Splatoon Raiders** como exclusivo demuestra el compromiso de Nintendo con sus IPs centrales, mientras que la llegada de títulos como **Lies of P** y **The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion Remastered** habla de sus esfuerzos para asegurar una biblioteca de software de terceros diversa y de alta calidad. Esta amplia gama de géneros y estilos de juego sugiere que **Switch 2** apunta a ser una consola versátil, capaz de satisfacer tanto a fans dedicados como a nuevos jugadores, asegurando un fuerte comienzo a su ciclo de vida.


## Próximos Pasos

Mientras que las fechas específicas para otros títulos como **Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters** y **Xenoblade Chronicles Switch 2 Edition** aún están por anunciarse, los lanzamientos confirmados pintan una imagen de un 2026 lleno de contenido. Mantén un ojo en futuros anuncios sobre **Orbitals**, **Another Eden Begins**, **Turok Origins**, **The Eternal Life of Goldman** y **Witchbrook**, todos programados para su lanzamiento a lo largo de 2026, solidificando aún más la ventana de lanzamiento prometedora de **Switch 2**.

content_raw: We now have our hands on the Nintendo Switch 2 , a new console from one of the biggest names in gaming. Alas, a new console is only as valuable as the library of games you can build on it. Thankfully, Nintendo hasn't been shy about planned releases over the next year. In the second half of 2026, we'll be getting our hands on a mix of Switch 2 exclusives, third-party releases, and the benefit of backward compatibility with any games still launching on the original Switch. Without further ado, here are all of the new Switch 2 games we can look forward to in 2026 and beyond. All Upcoming Switch 2 Games With Release Dates * indicates a Switch 2 exclusive Splatoon Raiders (July 23, 2026)* The next Splatoon game officially has a release date . The Switch 2-exclusive release will be single-player focused, letting you customize and control your own Mechanic, while supporting up to four players in co-op. It also looks to have a particularly big map that you progressively unlock throughout the game. Big Walk (August 4, 2026) From the creators of Untitled Goose Game comes what I would affectionately call a new addition to the friendslop genre. Which, again, is not a bad thing . This one lets you join up to 11 (!!) friends in an open world of puzzles and adventures, and of course features some good ol’ proxy chat. Lies of P: Complete Edition (August 6, 2026) One of the most beloved Souls-likes is getting a new ‘Complete Edition’ to accompany its launch on Switch 2. This new edition will include the Overture expansion as well as some quality of life improvements unique to the Nintendo console. It will be available to purchase digitally starting August 6, with a physical edition releasing later in October. The Elder Scrolls: Oblivion Remastered (August 11, 2026) Oblivion Remastered wasn't necessarily Bethesda's best-kept secret , but the day it 'shadow-dropped' was still one of the cooler Xbox moments in recent history. IGN's 8/10 review calls the full remake “a fantastic modernization” while acknowledging some "jank," including flubs left in for nostalgia's sake . In a somewhat active statement against the ongoing trend of digitization, Bethesda and Nintendo have confirmed that the Switch 2 edition of the Oblivion remake will be coming on a cartridge , which has already been selling out as a preorder . Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters (August 27, 2026) Now this is soccer. Or football. Whatever you want to call it, this game lets you pick from 22 national teams with over 110 playable characters to play it. The Captain Tsubasa sequel will include a singleplayer mode following the rise of the ‘king of sports anime’ (with tons of cut scenes) as well as online multiplayer modes. Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition (August 28, 2026) While we wait for more news about FromSoftware’s next game, The Duskbloods (which will be a Switch 2 exclusive), we finally know when the GOTY-winning masterpiece that is Elden Ring will be coming to the Nintendo console.
